integration_status in overrides.yml is empty — libco’s managed integration is not yet tracked there, so the “integration sold but not yet tracked” flag fires. Once approach/status is recorded, the flag will stop recurring.
feedback: The import_events CTE query from RUN_PROMPT.md § Step 1 (using file_types CTE + CROSS JOIN) was rejected by the Postgres MCP tool with “Error validating query.” Fell back to individual per-org queries with OR-chained ILIKE filters. The CTE syntax may need further adjustment for this tool’s SQL parser.

The customers table column for company name is name, not company_name. Phase_Anchors.md § Phase 7 references customers.company_name but the actual Postgres column is customers.name. Consider updating the framework to reflect the actual column name.

DRF’s customer import (April 27) is 51 days old — just barely within the 60-day window for Phase 3’s “≥2 file types in 60d” clause. If next week’s run happens on June 24+, that import will fall outside the window unless a new customer file is uploaded.

PEBL’s created_at (July 24, 2025) is 328 days ago, but the project formally started January 2026. The framework has no “project start date” override; created_at is the only computable value. The days_qualifier JSON field handles this gracefully.
No framework clauses were found ambiguous or contradicted by live data this run. The v3.4 framework applied cleanly.
